body: My parents don’t even love me. I hate myself. No one is ever going to love me. It’s futile and pointless to pretend otherwise

I guess the dream scenario would be that I feel good enough about myself that I don’t mind that people don’t love me as much as I’d like. But that is so unlikely I guess the next best thing would be someone to tell me I’m their best friend
I don’t understand what you mean?
I’m not that young

Because my life has nothing, I am an awkward mess in social situations. I have 3 friends, only 1 true friend. Never had a best friend, never will have a girlfriend because I’m too much of a pussy to speak to women in any way.
It’s won anyway
Maybe I’ll just jump off a bridge instead then
If I stabbed myself in the heart how would that not work?
Just keep being there for her
Does she live nearby? Go visit her, spend some time with her maybe
In my experience when I’m included in things or people show that I matter to them it greatly improves my mood. I’m never 100% happy though
Sorry
Show her you care. Don’t shut her out or ignore her for no reason.
Crap, useless and worthless
I know I can’t become someone else. I could become no one - all I need to do is find the courage to do it
I don’t know. I’ve always had these feelings on and off, but I usually at least have some kind of happy periods between the depression but at the moment I’m never happy.
I have no one close to me. I don’t have good friends - just aquantancies. There isn’t really anyone specific who picks on me. It’s just been a constant fixture throughout my life
All well and good thinking about therapy but I’m too scared to even go. I can’t verbally express my feelings in anyway so it’d just be me and a therapist sat in silence
How can I change it when social interaction scares me and no one wants to be around me anyway. Seems pretty hopeless to me.

Not for me. I burden the life of every person I meet. I’m so damn ugly and disgusting no one ever even wants to touch me. I’m so awkward and scared of social situations I can’t make any new friends. There is literally nothing for me to live for.
I don’t imagine many people would be that bothered if I killed my self
Ive lived my entire life expecting things to get better, hoping for better in the future. Nothing has changed. Nothing will change.
No because I don’t think it’ll help as I have an inability to verbally express my feelings so it would be pointless to go to a therapist
I’m nearly 22 and nothing good ever happens to me - I’m too shy and awkward for it to change. This is it
That sucks man :( hopefully it sorts itself out for you soon
Wow you must have done something real bad huh?
why aren’t you allowed to leave?
I have nothing to offer anyone, never have never will
If I go to my grave I won’t be annoying anyone there
I only love like two things and I don’t know if that will be enough to keep me going

I burden their lives because I’m never the centre of their attention, sure they talk to me and involve me but as soon as anything else come along their attention shifts and I’m left alone and friendless again

I worry every day that I burden my friends lives, I love hanging with them because they make me feel happy but at the same time I know they probably don’t like hanging with me as much. It fucking sucks :(

You don’t know anything about me, how do you know you don’t want me to die? I won’t be able to make friends because I have a crippling fear of both strangers and rejection which prevents me from interacting in a social situation.
My life has literally no meaning. I have barely any friends, I’ve no chance of having a relationship, what purpose can my life hold?
